episodeTitle.en: Succeeding as an introvert, building zero-to-one, and PM’ing your career like a product | Deb Liu
episodeTitle.zh: 作为内向者的成功之道：从0到1的构建，以及像产品经理般规划职业生涯 | 黛布·刘（Deb Liu）

guestBioOfficial.en: Deb Liu is the CEO of Ancestry and former longtime VP of Product at Facebook. At Facebook, Deb led the creation of Facebook Marketplace, developed the first mobile ad product for apps, built the company’s games business, and launched Facebook Pay. She’s also held leadership roles at PayPal and eBay, serves on the board of Intuit, and is the author of Take Back Your Power. In our conversation, we discuss: • Why you should PM your career like you PM your product
guestBioOfficial.zh: 黛布·刘（Deb Liu）现任Ancestry首席执行官，曾长期担任Facebook产品副总裁。在Facebook任职期间，她主导了Facebook Marketplace的开发，打造了首款移动应用广告产品，构建了公司的游戏业务，并推出了Facebook Pay。她还曾在PayPal和eBay担任领导职务，现任Intuit董事会成员，并著有《夺回你的力量》一书。在对谈中，我们探讨了：•为何你应该像管理产品一样管理自己的职业生涯

title.en: Succeeding as an introvert, building zero-to-one, and PM’ing your career like a product | Deb Liu
title.zh: 作为内向者的成功之道：从0到1的构建，以及像产品经理般规划职业生涯 | 黛布·刘（Deb Liu）

summary.en: Deb shares tactical career advice, including why resilience is key and how to “PM your career like you PM your product.” She discusses succeeding in business as an introvert by reframing self-promotion as “educating others about your team's great work,” and what she learned building multiple zero-to-one billion-dollar businesses inside Facebook. The conversation is full of hard-won wisdom on career, leadership, and impact.
summary.zh: Deb 分享了务实的职业建议，包括为何韧性关键，以及如何“像做产品一样做自己的职业生涯管理”。她讨论了内向者如何在职场成功——把自我推销重新定义为“让他人了解团队的出色工作”，以及在 Facebook 内部打造多个从 0 到 1 的十亿美元业务的所学。对话充满关于职业、领导与影响力的宝贵智慧。
